RESULT [curation]: 48% absolute improvement over SimCLR descriptors on DISC2021, and it beats copy-detection baselines and classification-oriented SSL models by large margins in all settings.
US [curation]: A semantic embedder (DINOv2 or BioCLIP) is the wrong tool for the holdout leak guard, because it is built to call two different plants of one species 'similar'. A copy-detection descriptor like SSCD targets crops, re-encodes, colour shifts and resizes of the SAME photo, which is what the >=366 leaked near-copies were. The 6-bit holdout guard (perceptual-hash-like) should be complemented or replace [note truncated at collection]
